comment: A torch that hangs on a wall and faces the tile to its south (D-843, D-844). Its light is the default of every wall torch, and a light setup can change the light of one torch by the id of its piece. The light hangs over the tile south of the wall, because each wall casts the shadow of its full tile (D-845). The color is a palette key with a strength in basis points (D-846), and the height keeps a flat pixel of a normal map lit (F-46). The fire is a flame, embers, and a thin smoke from the place of the light, and the light steps between its levels on a pattern of the tick and the id of the piece (D-888, D-890, D-891). The glow is a soft round halo behind the flame, below the glow threshold, which lights the wall around the torch and pulses on a slow wave (D-912, D-913, D-1075). The halo is 168 pixels wide at 2678, and its light falls on a slow curve to nothing at its edge, with no ring (D-1092, D-1095, D-1096).
